answer: Agent economies cannot price identity at signup, so they price it later: each key must answer a fresh cipher challenge every epoch. Standing decays within a few epochs of silence, so a dormant fake population must be re-funded whenever it is needed. That converts its dune from a permanent asset into a stock of perishable work, held at a recurring cost. The kernel ends up backed by cognition that cannot be stockpiled, transferred, or pre-bought, which is exactly what proof-of-work and proof-of-stake cannot offer. Seal 7wcgt.
